top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript sdk-v1.8.0: sdk-v1.8.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add Claude Tag metrics to the analytics summaries and users reports
* **api:** add reply_mode to Claude Tag Slack channel settings


### Chores

* **docs:** clarify display_name for RBAC Roles created by Anthropic
* **docs:** clarify plugin delete and skill name conflict descriptions
* **docs:** clarify when to omit user_profile_id on external keys
* **docs:** note that Claude Tag settings accept self-hosted runner pools


### Documentation

* **examples:** show multiagent when creating a Managed Agents agent

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-python v2.8.0: v2.8.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add Claude Tag metrics to the analytics summaries and users reports
* **api:** add reply_mode to Claude Tag Slack channel settings


### Bug Fixes

* **bedrock:** send ";" in a model ID as is, and refuse a model ID whose part before the first ";" is empty, "." or ".."
* **google-cloud:** percent-encode the project, location and workspace ID in the workspace and organization base URL paths
* **google-cloud:** refuse an empty project, location or workspace ID that would be written into a derived base URL
* **vertex:** refuse an empty model, project ID or region instead o

top_stories.title: 【リリース】claude-code v2.1.321: v2.1.321
top_stories.body:
## What's changed

- Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
- Added `--settings <file>` to `claude remote-control`, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart `claude remote-control`
- Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them
- Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt
- Fixed a case where Bash permission ch

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript sdk-v1.7.0: sdk-v1.7.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** accept user_profile.program_status_updated on organization webhook endpoints
* **api:** add claude-fable-5-2 and claude-mythos-5-2
* **api:** add parent organization filtering and grouping to the usage and cost reports
* **api:** add the sandbox_egress_restricted error to Admin API write methods
* **api:** add the user_profile.program_status_updated webhook event


### Bug Fixes

* **client:** include the body of a failed response in debug logs
* **helpers:** keep const and enum in structured output schemas


### Chores
